Hands tell a lot about daily sun exposure.🔅

From driving to walking outside, the skin on our hands is often left uncovered.

Over time, visible UV damage may appear as pigmentation, uneven tone, changes in texture, and skin laxity.

With ClearSkin Pro and Iris Dye SR, Alma offers technologies designed to help improve the appearance of skin texture, laxity, pigmentation, and overall tone.

Acne starts deeper than what we see. 🔍

It begins deep within the follicle, where bacteria trigger an immune response that fuels inflammation.

That’s why multiple causes must be treated together.

Iris Acne IPL helps reduce acne causing bacteria while calming inflammation.

At the same time, ClearSkin Pro1540 nanometers delivers precise energy deep into the dermis, helping regulate sebaceous gland activity.

Together, they help break the acne cycle, restore the skin’s natural balance, and support clearer, healthier looking skin. ✨

Think deep.

With deep sadness, we remember and honor Giuseppe Trudu, Founder of Alma Italia, Alma France, Alma Morocco, and AlmaCare.

For more than 14 years, he was much more than a Business Partner. He was a leader, an honest person, a rare soul, a man of big heart and immense generosity. Giuseppe embodied the spirit of Alma in a way that went far beyond business.

For many of us, he was a mentor, a father figure, and a friend, and he became an integral part of our lives. He loved Alma and, more than anything else, he believed in people.

In a world increasingly filled with artificial things, there was nothing artificial about him. He was genuine, honest, authentic. He was one of us.

We are grateful for his leadership, his friendship, and the legacy he leaves behind.

In his memory and with deep respect, we will continue to carry his spirit forward.

Thank you for everything you did for us.
Thank you for your loyalty.
Thank you for giving us your heart and soul.

And we at ALMA will always be there.

For You. For Life.

Years of sun damage gone in just 1 session and no downtime! Bio-Boost is here to take over the aesthetic industry 🤍👩🏼‍⚕️

Bio-Boost is the signature 2-in-1 combo using Alma’s most-loved lasers — ClearLift Pro + ClearSkin Pro — in a single session.

✨ ClearLift Pro → a gentle Q-switched 1064nm laser that works beneath the surface to soften the look of sun spots, pigmentation + uneven tone. The original “lunchtime laser” — zero downtime, zero peeling.

✨ ClearSkin Pro → a 1540nm Er:Glass laser with built-in cooling + vacuum tech. Refines the look of pores, texture + acne-prone skin while stimulating a fresh, glowy finish.

Together = brighter, clearer, smoother-looking skin in ONE appointment. No hiding. No recovery. Just glow.
